ella: quick needlecheck on needle7b variants — ran a ~1k-sample GTN slice (longform + chat) to compare compact vs fidelity quantizations.

ella: TL;DR: compact (int6-lose) gives ~2.9x cost reduction and ~15% lower latency vs fidelity (int8-preserve), but we see a consistent drop on long-answer recall (P@3 down ~6 points) and hallucination rate up on QA slices.

jin: can you paste the exact commands and sample split?

ella: command + split:
```
# smoke run
redwood eval --model needle7b-compact --quant int6 --samples gtn_longform_1k --batch 8 --traces
redwood eval --model needle7b-fidelity --quant int8 --samples gtn_longform_1k --batch 8 --traces
```
split: 70% multi-turn chat, 30% long-answer QA (~250-400 tokens)

eval-bot: auto metrics: compact(int6): avg_latency=64ms p95=130ms tokens_per_sec=340 cost_per_1k_tokens=$0.22; fidelity(int8): avg_latency=90ms p95=180ms tokens_per_sec=260 cost_per_1k_tokens=$0.78; recall_P@3 compact=0.71 fidelity=0.77; hallucination_rate compact=0.12 fidelity=0.07

ravi: significant cost delta. product question: which slices matter more for GTN usage patterns? short chat vs long docs?

sam_p: for GTN, ~60% short chats (<80 tokens), 40% long answers. Long answers have outsized user-visible regressions.

ella: recommendation: hybrid routing — default to compact for short chats (<80 tokens) and route any >120 tokens to fidelity. for mid-range (80-120) we can sample 10% to fidelity to monitor drift. Also propose a canary: 5% traffic to fidelity for 72h then expand if no regressions.

jin: ops checklist for canary? need latency SLOs, fallback, and cost alert thresholds.

ella: ops checklist (short):
- create rollout with 5% fidelity
- set automatic fallback to compact on p99 latency >500ms or error rate >1%
- add eval monitors: P@3 and hallucination delta alert if >3 points
- cost alert if spend > projected by 25%

sam_p: product OK with hybrid routing if we enforce recall alerting. also want a short summary slide for GTN PMs.

ella: I'll draft a 1-slide summary and schedule a 15-min sync. tagging @sam_p @ravi for next steps :thumbsup:
